rationale: The buyer is a specific, nameable group — SaaS founders and indie operators running transactional email on custom sending domains — who already pay for deliverability tooling (GlockApps, Postmark analytics, MXToolbox premium) and have a direct revenue incentive when email fails. The service can be built and operated nearly hands-off: automated DNS checks, reputation monitoring, and a daily digest generated by Claude, with no per-customer manual work. Total of 6.3 meets the build threshold on raw score, but responsiveness_signal is untested (scored 2) and the space has established competitors, so the right next step is a validation probe — a landing page and outreach to 20–30 founders — before committing to build. No build_gate is failing, but the responsiveness unknown keeps this at validate.
solution_plan: The micro-service is an automated email deliverability monitor and diagnostics report for founders sending on custom domains. The factory builds a Claude-powered daily check: it polls MX, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, checks blacklists via public APIs (MXToolbox-style), attempts a Google Postmaster Tools data pull where possible, and emails the operator a plain-English digest ('Your sending reputation is yellow; here is why and what to fix'). A simple landing page (e.g. Carrd) explains the service; a Stripe link handles $29/month subscriptions; an intake form collects the sending domain and contact email. To sell, the factory sends cold outreach (one approval gate per batch) to founders visible on ProductHunt, Indie Hackers, or recent HN 'Show HN' posts who mention running transactional email — a public, high-intent list. Delivery is fully automated: Claude runs the checks, writes the digest, and sends it via a transactional email provider (Postmark/Resend); billing runs through Stripe; the only recurring human step is approving each outreach batch before it sends. The main competitor risk is that GlockApps and MXToolbox already exist — the wedge is a simpler, founder-friendly onboarding experience and plain-English AI-written interpretation, not raw feature depth.
notes: No build_gate fails: operational_autonomy=8 (≥7), buildability_with_ai=8 (≥6), buyer_clarity=7 (≥6), willingness_to_pay=6 (≥5). Stage capped at validate (not build) solely because responsiveness_signal is untested. Run a 20-contact cold outreach probe; if reply rate hits 8%+ with at least 2 trial signups, promote to build.
